newsitem.title: GERMANY: German forwarders pick new aircargo committee head.
newsitem.headline: German forwarders pick new aircargo committee head.

text.p: German freight forwarders' association BSL said Wolf-Dietrich von Helldorff has been elected chairman of its air cargo committee.
Von Helldorff, German air cargo director of Kuehne & Nagel (AG & Co), replaces Dieter Alheit, who stepped down after 10 years in the post, a BSL statement said.
Following his election, von Helldorff said he would seek to improve the status of air cargo forwarders within the logistics chain and improve co-operation with airlines.
Forwarders and carriers also needed to address the challenges of modern technology both in communications and in operations, he added.
